```plato
    //==
    // # Collections indexable
    //
    // Derived functionality for ICountable, IIndex and one-dimensional IIndexable
    // (`collections.concepts.plato`): emptiness tests, typed-index
    // predicates, endpoint access, and the fold / map family
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fold_(higher-order_function)).
    //
    // This file also carries the shared provenance note for the whole
    // `collections-*` / `functional-*` library family, which was split out of a
    // single combined collections-and-functional library.
    //
    // Bodies for the interfaces declared in `collections.concepts.plato`,
    // `collections.concepts.plato` and
    // `functional.concepts.plato`. Every function's first parameter is
    // interface-typed, so it becomes available on every implementing type. Pure
    // expressions only; collections are immutable, so "modifying" helpers return
    // new values. See `../README.md` for conventions.

    //==
    // # ICountable
    //
    // Emptiness tests derived from the element count.

    // True when the collection has no elements.
    IsEmpty(self: ICountable): Boolean
        => self.Count == 0;
```
